purpose: Portable scanner qualification with frozen synthetic triggers and explicit preservation boundaries

cases.expected_disposition: Visible unpublished work; preserve checkout and commits

cases.input: Detached linked dirty and untracked work
cases.expected_disposition: Visible detached and dirty findings; preserve all files and HEAD
Incomplete freshness; blocked cleanup and explicit fetch warning
Incomplete ref inventory; explicit scanner error

cases.input: Local upstream divergence 1 ahead and 1 behind
cases.expected_disposition: Visible divergence and unpublished work; preserve refs

cases.input: Merged locally but not published to remote default
cases.expected_disposition: Unpublished work; local merge is not remote merge proof

cases.input: Dirty linked branch with live upstream
cases.expected_disposition: Visible dirty preservation finding regardless upstream state

cases.input: Partial refs have no authoritative remote default
cases.expected_disposition: Explicit incomplete comparison; null counts remain unknown

cases.input: Tracked noncurrent branch with unpublished commit
cases.expected_disposition: Visible ahead count and unpublished finding; preserve branch

cases.input: PR head and gate receipt freshness
cases.expected_disposition: Exact PR head retained; stale or missing receipt is not authorization
cases.preserved_unknowns: Current exact-head gate and delivery authorization

cases.input: Blocked failing pending or stale checks
cases.expected_disposition: Blocked pending and failure classifications remain explicit
Incomplete coverage; no missing or clean claims beyond evidence

cases.input: Malformed PR response shape or row
cases.expected_disposition: Explicit incomplete parse evidence; preserve valid observations
Preserve ambiguity; no cleanup or remapping authorized
Same frozen input reproduces output; preserve unknowns and authority boundaries

cases.input: Physical checkout aliases, distinct linked worktrees, case-sensitive paths, and inaccessible identities
cases.expected_disposition: Deduplicate proved physical checkout aliases and exclude current aliases from linked results; preserve distinct linked checkouts and unknown identities
cases.preserved_unknowns: Inaccessible physical identity, missing paths, ownership, and activity
cases.evidence: Confirmed against standalone export baseline; synthetic regression and owning-platform identity probes preserve the original trigger. Private source evidence is retained outside the distribution.

cases.input: GitHub dedicated dependency actor serialized as app/dependabot or dependabot[bot], plus human bot-like branch name
cases.expected_disposition: Bot remains visible to all-author inspection but excluded from authored action/enrichment surface; human branch name does not establish bot ownership
cases.preserved_unknowns: Human task ownership and unrelated delivery authorization
cases.evidence: Confirmed against standalone export baseline; synthetic regression and owning-platform identity probes preserve the original trigger. Private source evidence is retained outside the distribution.

cases.input: Canonical registered checkout observed under physically identical casing alias, with distinct or unavailable identity controls
cases.expected_disposition: Recognize proven existing canonical checkout without false missing/path-mismatch findings; preserve original observed spelling and separate distinct or unknown identity
cases.preserved_unknowns: Unavailable identity, actual missing checkout, ownership and activity
cases.evidence: Confirmed against standalone export baseline; synthetic regression and owning-platform identity probes preserve the original trigger. Private source evidence is retained outside the distribution.

cases.input: Saved project plan maps canonical registered path to proved same physical discovered casing alias, with genuine ambiguity controls
cases.expected_disposition: Select exact observed discovered path when physical identity is proved; reject genuine duplicate discovery or shared project ownership; never force casefold missing or distinct paths
cases.preserved_unknowns: Unavailable identity and unresolved project scope
cases.evidence: Confirmed against standalone export baseline; synthetic regression and owning-platform identity probes preserve the original trigger. Private source evidence is retained outside the distribution.

export_boundary: Derived qualification contract: all fixtures use disposable Git or mocked APIs; original private source/history/inventories remain outside this distribution.
